# trending.md
A dense trending information listing optimized for agentic web search. Markdown-first. Updated every 15 minutes.

## Feeds
- Latest: https://trending.md/feed/latest.md (today's trending items, ranked by velocity)
- Archive: https://trending.md/feed/2026-08-11.md | https://trending.md/feed/2026-08-10.md | https://trending.md/feed/2026-08-09.md

## About
- https://trending.md/about.md (project description + agent consumption guide)
- https://trending.md/archive/index.md (full archive listing)

## Optional
